name: rust-faf-mcp
description: RMCP-powered FAF server. 9 tools. Rust-native MCP for IANA-registered .faf format.
long_description:
Rust-native MCP server for FAF (Foundational AI-context Format). Built with rmcp 3.0.1 (MCP Tier 1 foundation) and faf-rust-sdk. 9 tools for reading, scoring, syncing, and managing .faf project DNA files. Registry identity: one.faf/rust-faf-mcp.

**Tools:** faf_init, faf_git, faf_read, faf_score, faf_sync, faf_compress, faf_discover, faf_tokens, faf_auto

**Why Rust?** Zero-dependency binary. No Node.js, no Python, no runtime. Just the binary.

**IANA-registered MIME type (application/vnd.faf+yaml).**

tools.name: faf_init
tools.description: Create or enhance a project.faf file

tools.name: faf_git
tools.description: Generate .faf from a GitHub repo URL

tools.name: faf_auto
tools.description: Zero to AI context in one command
